detail.longDescription: ChatGPT can do basically anything you ask, but you really don't have a huge amount of control over its outputs. If you want to do more with OpenAI's models, you need to dig a little deeper. If you really want to see what the models can do and exert some control over how they respond, you need to get your hands properly dirty and play around with the API. That way, you can really pull the levers that control what they can create. Here's how to go about doing it. How to use the OpenAI playground
